findings.correction: It wasn’t irritation. I was simply suspicious.
findings.current: I wasn’t merely annoyed. I was suspicious.
findings.defect: Negation flipped: the source denies irritation and allows only suspicion; “wasn’t merely annoyed” keeps annoyance and adds suspicion.
findings.rationale: 짜증이 아니다 is a full negation, not a hedge under 단지/단지 …만이 아니다. 그저 … 뿐이다 limits the reaction to suspicion alone.
findings.source: 짜증이 아니다. 그저 의심이 들 뿐이다.

findings.correction: This was on an entirely different level from anything I had experienced.
findings.current: What I had experienced before was on an entirely different level.
findings.defect: Comparison subject reversed: the new killing intent, not prior monster killing intent, is the thing on another level.
findings.rationale: 그것과는 marks prior experience as the baseline. The following 하급/중급 contrast treats Lee Seogeun’s killing intent as the stronger, more refined one.
findings.source: 내가 겪어 온 그것과는 차원이 다르다.

findings.correction: At the Jin Family of Taiyuan gate guard’s tense question, the young man in the lead smiled. Hostility he could not hide seeped from his crooked, lifted lips.
findings.current: At the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s gate, the tense gatekeeper received an answer from the young man leading the group. His lips curled into a crooked smile, unmistakable hostility seeping through.
findings.defect: The narrated action is the lead youth smiling at the gate guard’s tense question, not the gatekeeper receiving an answer; location “at the gate” is also added.
findings.rationale: 물음에 … 웃었다 is cause then smile. 수문위사 is the asker; 선두의 청년 is the one who smiles before “항산.”
findings.source: 태원진가 수문위사의 긴장 섞인 물음에 선두의 청년이 웃었다. 비뚜름하게 올라간 입술에는 감출 수 없는 적의가 배어 있었다.

findings.correction: I was now a Murim martial artist who had learned a Peak cultivation technique and two First Rate martial arts.
findings.current: The person I was now was a Murim martial artist who had mastered a Peak cultivation technique and two First Rate martial arts.
findings.defect: 익힌 is acquired/learned proficiency; “mastered” overstates stage and completeness.
findings.rationale: The same chapter places cultivation at the Third Stage and the two arts at the Fourth Stage, which does not support mastery.
findings.source: 지금의 나는 절정 심법에 일류 무공을 두 개나 익힌 무림인이다.

findings.correction: had a glass of soju with the hyung from the goshiwon
findings.current: drank a glass of soju with the goshiwon manager
findings.defect: 형 is an older male associate at the goshiwon; “manager” invents a role and identity the source does not state.
findings.rationale: Nothing in the chapter identifies 고시원 형 as the proprietor or manager.
findings.source: 고시원 형이랑 소주 한잔 걸친 다음에

findings.correction: I was at a goshiwon, you bastard.[^1] with a first-use note that a goshiwon is a very small, cheap room-for-rent.
findings.current: I was at a goshiwon, you bastard.
findings.defect: 고시원 is kept, but the binding footnote example for this living arrangement is missing.
findings.rationale: Footnote rules require a brief living-arrangement note at the first meaningful 고시원 occurrence.

findings.correction: That was when the rims of my eyes started to go red.
findings.current: That was when my eyes began to sting.
findings.defect: About-to-redden eye rims (onset of tears) is flattened into sting, already used for 코끝이 찡하다.
findings.rationale: 눈시울이 붉어지려던 is a visible prelude to crying, not a sting.

findings.defect: 싸다 is undifferentiated relief (often defecation) after 볼일; “piss” narrows and slightly sanitizes.
findings.rationale: 변소/볼일 then 싸십시오 is crude permission to void on the spot, not specifically urination.

findings.defect: 개새끼 is stronger than “bastard” and is slightly sanitized.
findings.rationale: Profanity rules require matching strength; 개새끼 is a stronger insult than 새끼/bastard.

findings.correction: Fwoosh! or a rustling scatter such as Flutter!
findings.defect: Wrong sound: 촤르륵 is papers rustling/scattering, not a whoosh.
findings.rationale: The next line is a bundle of papers hitting the face and spreading on the floor.

findings.correction: just by dealing with idiot bandits like Cheon Ryeokbu
findings.current: just by dealing with idiots like Cheon Ryeokbu and his bandits
findings.defect: Adds “and his bandits,” turning type-comparison into that man plus his gang.
findings.rationale: 같은 marks bandits of Cheon Ryeokbu’s kind, not necessarily Cheon Ryeokbu’s own band.

findings.correction: and now I’m working hard toward Logout
findings.current: now I’m working hard to log out
findings.defect: Glossary term Logout is rendered as the ordinary verb “log out.”
findings.rationale: Binding glossary maps 로그아웃 to Logout as the system/quest term.

findings.correction: far more refined, more furtive, and more chilling
findings.current: His killing intent was far more refined, more discreet, and more chilling.
findings.rationale: The contrast is stealthy, creeping killing intent versus blunt monster malice.
findings.source: 훨씬 다듬어져 있고, 은밀하며 소름 끼친다.

findings.correction: Hyuk Mujin, his abdomen pierced through, let out a rueful sigh.
findings.current: Hyuk Mujin, his abdomen pierced through, let out a groan.
findings.defect: 탄식하다 is a rueful sigh/lament that cues his next line, not a pain-groan.
findings.rationale: 탄식 matches the following appraisal “실력이 빨리도 느는군,” not an injury cry.

summary: Several semantic defects: a negated emotion is flipped, the gate youth’s smile is recast as the gatekeeper receiving an answer, killing-intent comparison is inverted in one sentence, 익히다 is overstated as mastery, and 고시원 형 is identified as a manager. Smaller register, onomatopoeia, and glossary/footnote misses remain.
